denomination.note: MFL pools EVERY draft on its platform into one ADP, so this is not denominated in the same thing our board is. Measured on 2026-09-04: 33 of the 190 rows priced inside pick 150 (17.4%) sit at positions this league cannot roster at all. A gap between this market and our board is therefore NOT evidence that our board is wrong. `board_vs_market` measures the superflex and dynasty signatures directly; read them before attributing any gap.
